metric: 12–16 second forward executable closing-spread quote error, bps
ranking_rule: All-run MAE ascending on equal scored counts; tie-break all-run RMSE, then fixed model order.
interpretation: Forecasts were frozen at each anchor. Retained rows may omit older anchors; The snapshot has no per-block censor timestamps, so block coverage cannot be reconstructed. opposite directions and adjacent anchor outcomes can be correlated. These are quote-bps errors, not independent trials, fills, cash P&L, or trading profit.
